title: Tenant boundary certification bundles for Dedicated capacity
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Goal: deliver an automated "attestation bundle" feature for Dedicated tenants that compiles cryptographically-signed evidence proving data residency, retention configuration, and logical/physical tenant isolation for audit and compliance requests. The bundle must be usable by auditors (PDF) and by programmatic tooling (machine-readable JSON), and stored with tamper-evident signatures.

Background: customers running in Dedicated capacity request formal artifacts to prove where data lives, how long it is retained, and how tenant boundaries are enforced (node allocation, network segmentation, encryption). Current evidence is ad-hoc: a mix of screenshots, logs, and manual exports. This ticket scopes an on-demand and scheduled generator that collects a standard set of artifacts, validates them against expected tenant policy, and produces a signed bundle per-tenant and per-period.

Scope: collection and schema definition for residency manifests, retention snapshots, and isolation proofs; signer integration (KMS/HSM); storage and retention of bundles in per-customer audit buckets; Console UI for download + an API endpoint for programmatic retrieval; access control for who can request/generate bundles. Excludes: revamping infra-level isolation (this ticket only collects evidence, not change allocation logic).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Schema: a documented JSON schema for the attestation bundle exists in Confluence and is approved by Security.
2) Collection: service successfully collects residency manifest, retention policy snapshot, encryption metadata, and tenant-node allocation map for 3 dedicated demo tenants.
3) Signing: each bundle is signed with KMS; signature verifies with the published public key.
4) Storage: bundles stored in per-tenant audit bucket with lifecycle rules; retrieval API returns both signed JSON and rendered PDF.
4b) Bundles are immutable once written and include timestamped SHA-256 checksums.
5) Console: UI modal allows authorized users to generate and download a bundle; audit event emitted for generation.
6) Automation: weekly scheduled bundles are generated and a failure alert appears in SLO dashboard.
7) Documentation: runbook for reviewers and an export example for SOC2 auditors.
8) QA: end-to-end test that verifies signature, schema compatibility, and ability to import into third-party audit tool.
proposed_solution: Build a small 'attestation-collector' microservice (Go) that runs in Dedicated management plane and orchestrates collectors: (1) residency collector (region mapping, IP ranges, cloud account IDs), (2) retention collector (S3 lifecycle, DB TTLs, object-store retention flags), (3) isolation collector (k8s node labels, pod-to-node mapping, VRF/NSM info, vpc routing table snapshot), (4) encryption proof collector (volume/obj encryption metadata and KMS key IDs), and (5) access-sample collector (time-bounded snippets of access logs/anomaly indicators). The collectors write normalized pieces to a staging area, the attestation-collector composes them into the bundle per the schema, signs with the configured KMS key (support for customer-managed keys optional), persists to the per-tenant audit bucket, and emits an audit log and Console event. Provide both PDF renderer (server-side templating) and machine JSON. Use a backfill/adapter layer so existing evidence from ENG-9420 and ENG-8246 can be consumed.
implementation_tasks: Draft JSON/PDF schema and approval: Confluence -> security review
Implement residency collector: query placement service and cloud account mappings
Implement retention collector: snapshot S3 lifecycle rules, DB TTL config, and object retention flags
Implement isolation collector: gather k8s node assignment, node labels, CNI routes, and host-level tenancy tags
Implement encryption collector: collect volume/PV encryption metadata and KMS key identifiers
Build attestation-collector service: compose, sign (KMS integration), store, and emit audit event
Console UI: add 'Generate Attestation' action and download workflow with RBAC guard
E2E tests: verify bundle integrity, signature validation, and UI download for demo tenants
Automation: scheduled job (weekly) and failure alert wired into SLO dashboard
Docs: runbook, API spec, sample bundle for auditors
Security review and KMS rotation playbook
Release and migration plan: seed 3 pilot tenants and run a 2-week validation window
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal pilot for 3 dedicated tenants (non-customer) - validate collectors and signatures. Phase 2: limited customer pilot with 2 compliance-focused customers behind a private feature flag. Phase 3: GA for all Dedicated tenants; enable weekly scheduled bundles by default and allow per-tenant opt-out. Monitor for collector failure rates and storage costs.
monitoring_and_alerting:
- Bundle generation success/failure rate (per-tenant)
- Collector latency and error counts for each collector
- Signature verification failures
- S3/storage size per-tenant and retention rule violations
- Alert: generate.P0 when weekly job fails for >24h for a tenant with 'high' compliance flag
- Dashboard: per-tenant attestation health view in Console operations tab
